description: Career portal registry for the InternHunt crawler. `careers_url` is the page Playwright loads; `fallback_urls` are alternates tried by scripts/verify_portals.py when the primary fails. A null `careers_url` means the company has no reachable public careers page - the verifier and the seeder both skip those entries.
